note: Mellow Bike Map's low-stress-street geometry, buffer-matched against the published CDOT bike_routes layer (25 m buffer, projected to EPSG:26916) and deduped: mellow ships pre-split into block-length parts, and any part that falls within the buffer of a real bike_routes segment is dropped as a duplicate (bike_routes wins). The remainder ships here as connector-tier geometry (facility_category 'mellow', data_tier crowdsourced) — the network map's replacement for the retired standalone mellow overlay. Connectors are identity-less, so all surviving parts collapse into ONE MultiLineString feature (same shape as mellow_routes.geojson); its `parts` property is the kept-part count, which is also what meta.json reports as this source's `records`. mellow_routes.geojson itself is unchanged and keeps shipping for any other page that reads it. This run dropped 34.1% of mellow route miles as duplicates of on-street bike infrastructure.
